prompt: A user reports the CLI tool they installed has 'inconsistent behavior' — sometimes commands work, sometimes they hit 'command not found' or 'config missing'. Run a structured doctor diagnosis: ordered checks (binary on PATH and which copy, version, config-dir presence and ownership, config-file schema match, plugin/skill registration, hook directory state, validation script results if any), pass criterion per check, status (OK/WARN/CRITICAL) per check, recommended fixes ranked by safety, and explicit confirm-first rule for anything destructive.
